newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR EXTENDS LOSSES ON KEY UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR EXTENDS LOSSES ON KEY UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar extended its losses against major currencies in a short, hectic interbank market on Thursday, forcing the central bank to intervene to stop it from sliding further, foreign exchange dealers said.
"The market was very hectic today. We opened at 11.67/68 (against the key U.S. dollar) and went as high as 11.73/76 then the central bank came in and to put in a bit of liquidity," one dealer said.
Towards Thursday's close, the dollar was quoted five cents weaker on the U.S. unit at 11.7200/7400 from its 11.6700/6800 position late Wednesday.

It also lost ground to sterling against which it was indicatd at 18.5800/6800 from 18.3600/4080 and was also weaker at 6.3500/3700 on the mark -- despite the German currency's losses to the U.S. dollar overseas -- versus 6.3200/3290.
It was however marginally firmer on the rand at 2.5000/5100 compared to 2.5020/5050.
